items.label: Buckled floor planks
items.note: Living room flooring has buckled and lifted roughly 2 cm due to prolonged water saturation.

items.label: Debris in hallway
items.note: Miscellaneous debris washed into the hallway during the flood.

items.label: Dislodged kitchen debris
items.note: Dislodged cabinet contents and packaging scattered across the kitchen floor.

items.label: Waterlogged debris
items.note: Waterlogged books and papers displaced onto the living room floor.

items.label: Refrigerator tipped over
items.note: Refrigerator was tipped by the flood surge and now partially blocks the kitchen walkway.

items.label: Flooded furnace
items.note: Furnace was fully submerged during the flood. Electrical and combustion components likely compromised -- CO and fire risk, do not operate.

items.label: Structural crack in hallway partition wall
items.note: Diagonal structural crack in the hallway/closet partition wall. Recommend a structural engineer assessment before re-occupancy.

items.label: Submerged electrical outlet near water heater
items.note: Outlet is below the waterline directly adjacent to the flooded water heater. Highest-priority electrical hazard in the house.

items.label: Submerged electrical outlet
items.note: Outlet sits below the flood waterline. Shock/fire risk -- do not energize until inspected by a licensed electrician.

items.label: Submerged electrical outlet
items.note: Outlet sits below the flood waterline. Shock/fire risk -- do not energize until inspected by a licensed electrician.

items.label: Submerged electrical outlet
items.note: Outlet sits below the flood waterline. Shock/fire risk -- do not energize until inspected by a licensed electrician.

items.label: Ceiling water stain (wind-driven rain)
items.note: Stain near the kitchen ceiling line is above the flood waterline and consistent with wind-driven rain intrusion through the roof/window, not groundwater flooding -- a separate peril to adjudicate.

items.label: Mold growth near water heater
items.note: Visible mold growth on the closet wall above the water heater, indicating prolonged moisture exposure. Air quality concern.

items.label: Mold growth on kitchen wall
items.note: Mold is spreading at the base of the east kitchen wall below the waterline.

items.label: Residual mud/silt on floor
items.note: Approximately 3 cm of mud and silt coats all flooring throughout the house.

items.label: Water-soaked rug
items.note: Area rug is saturated and stained; likely a total loss.

items.label: Water-soaked sofa
items.note: Upholstered sofa is fully saturated and shows water staining; total loss, mold risk if not removed quickly.

items.label: Swollen/warped baseboard
items.note: Baseboard trim in the kitchen is warped and separating from the wall below the waterline.

items.label: Swollen/warped baseboard
items.note: Baseboard trim in the living room is warped and separating from the wall below the waterline.

items.label: Swollen lower cabinet (east run)
items.note: Particleboard cabinet carcass has swollen and delaminated from water absorption.

items.label: Swollen lower cabinet (north run)
items.note: Particleboard cabinet carcass has swollen and delaminated from water absorption.

items.label: Flooded water heater
items.note: Water heater was fully submerged during the flood. Electrical/gas components are likely compromised -- do not operate.

items.label: Flood waterline
items.note: Waterline visible on all walls at approximately 0.9 m; flooding reached mid-wall height throughout the house.
